name: services/exams/batch_registration
description: Method combines methods batch_unregister_exam and batch_register_exam in one. Firstly unregisters users using parameter "unregister", then registers users using parameter "register".
brief_description: Unregister and register multiple users at one request

arguments.name: unregister
arguments.description:
Dictionary mapping groups numbers to dictionaries mapping slots numbers to lists of user IDs that should
            be unregistered.

arguments.name: register
arguments.description:
Dictionary mapping groups numbers to dictionaries mapping slots numbers to lists of users IDs that should
            be registered.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
Dictionary of following fields mapping user IDs to one of following statuses:
  • unregister_result - dictionary that returns method batch_unregister_exam
  • register_result - dictionary that returns method batch_register_exam
errors: • object_not_found - some of the referenced objects do not exist; param_name is equal to exam_id.
